pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions display high edge angularity with complex, serrated boundaries. Gradients between dark patches and light corridors are sharp. Spatial area of patches is maximal on the mid-flank and decreases toward the posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative-space corridors form a continuous lattice of narrow pixel thickness. Junction nodes occur at high frequency, creating a complex interconnected web of light pelage separating the primary dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The silhouette of the mane along the dorsal ridge shows a repetitive, low-amplitude serrated pattern. Individual tufts create a jagged 1D profile against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Two avian organisms (likely oxpeckers) are attached to the lateral surface; one is located on the upper shoulder/neck with a visible red pixel cluster at the head, and another is located on the mid-dorsal flank.
